svg.aria-label: Simplified world map of the spread of Homo sapiens out of Africa: origin in Africa about 300,000 years ago, main dispersal from 60,000 to 70,000 years ago, reaching Australia by about 65,000 years ago, Europe by about 45,000 years ago and the Americas by at least 15,000 years ago, with earlier sorties such as Misliya Cave in Israel about 180,000 years ago
svg.text: Out of Africa: how Homo sapiens spread
Simplified routes and approximate arrival times (ka = thousand years ago)
Main dispersal from Africa: ~60,000–70,000 years ago
Routes are schematic. Map outline: Natural Earth (public domain).
